title: Interception of Illicit Consignment & E-Way Bill Forgery
summary: Police team intercepted white Scorpio UP14 AB 1234 parked near Sector 18 market. Driver fled on foot. Seized 14 fake consignment vouchers bearing seal of Apex Global Logistics and delivery address of Zenith Import-Export Mumbai. An individual identified in spot inquiry as R. Kumar was observed exiting vehicle minutes prior.

title: Cash Diversion & Unauthorized Freight Yard Operation
police_station: Vasant Kunj Police Station, South-West Delhi
summary: Intelligence raid on unauthorized warehouse facility off NH-48. Recovered unaccounted cash packets and shipping logs connecting Vikram Malhotra of Apex Logistics and Tariq Sheikh of Mumbai.

title: Cross-Border Hawala Settlement Intercept
police_station: Bandra Kurla Complex Police Station, Mumbai
summary: Crime Branch unit detained financial controller Amit Sharma outside Trade Centre BKC. Recovered ledger sheets detailing cross-state fund routing via Kuber Financial Services and Apex Logistics accounts.

title: Tax Evasion & Shell Company Warehouse Raid
police_station: Okhla Industrial Area PS, South-East Delhi
summary: State GST enforcement raid on Plot 42 Okhla facility. Shell invoices recovered linking Metro Freight Carriers and WestCoast Shipping.

title: Contraband Clearance via Forged Manifest
summary: Customs preventive wing impounded shipping container #MSCU-881290. Documentation submitted by WestCoast Shipping under instructions from Zenith Import-Export.

title: Encrypted VoIP & Fake Identity Syndicate
